channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Canada, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Canada, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Alberta Foundation for the Arts: Visual Arts and New Media Individual Project Funding (March 2027)
item.description: Alberta Foundation for the Arts · deadline 01 Mar 2027 · Up to CAD 18,000 per project. No application fee.

item.title: Ontario Arts Council: Media Artists Creation Projects (October 2026 deadline)
item.description: Ontario Arts Council · deadline 08 Oct 2026 · Emerging: maximum CAD 10,000; Mid-Career and Established: maximum CAD 40,000. No application fee.

item.title: Manitoba Arts Council: Create Grant (October 2026 intake)
item.description: Manitoba Arts Council · deadline 10 Oct 2026 · Emerging: up to CAD 7,500; Mid-career: up to CAD 10,000; Established: up to CAD 15,000. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grant - week of 06 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Inside Out RE:Focus Fund Post-Production Grants 2026
    https://insideout.ca/initiatives/re-focus-fund/
    Inside Out (Toronto 2SLGBTQ+ Film Festival) · deadline 22 Jul 2026 · Post-production grant funding to support the completion and promotion of short and feature films; the requested amount is set by the applicant (see the FAQ 'How much funding can I request?'). Since 2018 the RE:Focus Fund has distributed more than CAD 300,000 in grants and programs. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grant - week of 29 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Call to Artists: Walden Fire Station and Library (Calgary Arts Development)
    https://calgaryartsdevelopment.com/public-art/opportunities/all/call-to-artists-walden-fire-station-and-library/
    Calgary Arts Development (CADA) · deadline 28 Jul 2026 · Total project budget of CAD 275,000 (exclusive of all applicable taxes) for one selected artist/artist team. The artist fee for the total project is CAD 68,750 + GST. Budget breakdown can be adapted to the artist's approach, following CARFAC's recommendation that a minimum 20% of the budget go to the artist's fee; the total allocated budget will not be increased.
